verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents stakeholder access to a centralized cap table platform (eqvista-docs-6), a setting that controls which shareholders can see equity values (eqvista-docs-16), and a feature to create and share messages (eqvista-docs-15). Together these suggest investors can log in to see their holdings and receive updates from inside the platform. Most of this evidence is bare support-article titles or one-line marketing claims, so the depth of the investor-facing view and of structured updates is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an investor-specific portal showing individual holdings, detail on structured investor updates (templates, metrics, recurring reports), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the investor experience.
